2. 'Texture anomaly/Plastic look' (Router severity 1.5): I will increase this to 2.0. The surface resembles clay or plastic more than frozen dairy.
3. 'Sauce streaks/Painted look' (Router severity 2.5): I agree. The yellow/red streaks lack fluid dynamics (viscosity, edge tension) and look like 2D smears.
